maxillary_keypoint_topology.keypoint_spatial_matrix: The uppermost keypoints are positioned at a dorsal offset of approximately 1.5 spot-diameters from the dense secondary row, following a trajectory near-parallel to the superior labial margin.

rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: Melanin-heavy pixels account for approximately 20% of the visible rhinarium, concentrated along the lateral margins and the inferior philtrum, with the central apex exhibiting 80% pale/pinkish pigmentation.

other_distinctive_markers: Localized clustering of Diptera insects on the rhinarium and distal muzzle skin.
